facts.fact: Jehan 起初并不打算与 Ysabel 固定共进午餐；他本是想和她上床，事情却偶然变成了午餐
facts.anchor: It had happened by accident when he was trying to have sex with her.

facts.fact: Clement 确认那张便条是 Ysabel 的笔迹，指出她写字太快会把词的中段连在一起，并据此断言有人杀了她
facts.anchor: She always writes so fast she runs the middle of words together

facts.fact: Alys 怀疑 Rogier Saige 可能为窃取 Ysabel 关于 echo headaches 的研究成果而杀她
facts.anchor: Ysabel’s research project was on echo headaches. That’s one of Saige’s specialties.

facts.fact: Moyna 反驳 Estiene 的燃尽说，称全届中最不可能燃尽的人就是 Ysabel
facts.anchor: Of everyone in our cohort, she’s the last person I’d expect.

facts.fact: Jehan 的母亲、资深 medic Colette Fortier 与 Head Healer Marcelle 争吵，指责学院自 serrage 以来不断降低录取学者所需的魔力门槛
facts.anchor: since the serrage the Academie has been lowering the threshold of magic needed

facts.fact: Estiene 告诉 Jehan，Danisy 当天下午要主持一场极复杂的宫内疗愈，而他父亲说如果他有上午考试时段，阵列里也许有他的位置
facts.anchor: Danisy is directing a healing this afternoon. In utero. Very complex.

facts.fact: 在储藏室里两人接吻后，Estiene 说 No 并后退道歉；Jehan 提醒他，一个月前正是他结束了两人关系，那次分手感觉是最终的了断
facts.anchor: But that last break, only a month ago, had felt excruciatingly, humiliatingly final.

facts.fact: 九年前剧院重开后的首场公开疗愈中，抗议者向疗愈师投掷燃烧瓶，两名疗愈师濒死但被同伴救活，病人死亡
facts.anchor: hurled rag-wicked bottles of burning spirits down amongst the healers
